basic_profile.bio: I'm a long-time Reddit user currently based in Edmonton, Alberta. I've always had a passion for chemistry, which led me to pursue a degree in the subject at the University of Alberta. Outside of my academic pursuits, I'm deeply interested in exploring my identity, particularly through the lens of demisexuality. I’m a huge fan of mystery series, especially classic ones like Perry Mason. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which is a perfect fit given my love for reading. I’m in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending weekends hiking in the Rockies or exploring local markets. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work or class.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong background in chemistry from my undergraduate studies, I often engage in educational subreddits to both learn and share knowledge. My expertise is rooted in formal education, but I also enjoy self-teaching through online resources and community discussions.
